subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Place the green shoe inside the open cardboard box on the left, with its toe facing left.
Use the left arm to pick up the green shoe in the foreground and place it in the left cardboard box with its toe facing left. Retract the empty right arm.
Use the left arm to place the mallet inside the cardboard box with its head facing left. Lift clear of the rim and keep the shoe inside.
Use the left gripper to pack the toy police car into the cardboard box on the left, with the front of the car facing left.
Pick up the white electric toothbrush and put it in the cardboard box with its bristle end facing left. Then return both grippers home.
Use the left arm to pick up the white toothbrush in front of the box and place it inside the box, keeping its bristles facing left. Return both arms home.
